scope: Actual task-owned native process trees incl.Ollama; shared desktop, no Docker cgroups; browser/test/build/unrelated apps excluded
limitations: Restart interval resets CPU counters; positive deltas only
One model loaded at a time; samples include multiple test configurations
Raw non-atomic group deltas show counter artifacts around process/model replacements; raw peak is not physical CPU utilization
CPU estimate excludes group-size/counter regressions and values exceeding8core capacity; use proper cgroup accounting on the target
